items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: and so he was replaced with Don Murray in the band because of that

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. The Wolverines were always waiting for Hoagie to come out with another crazy one, or the Marahue brothers down in Indiana. There were others around, you know, at that time. Bob Gillette, who played banjo with the Wolverines, played often with the Rhythm Kings. And Don Murray. And I think Don made angry with them. I think Don was with them a lot, as a matter of fact, on tenor, after Jack Pettis. When we were talking about taking up music as a profession on the part of the Austin boys, everybody knew that…
and so he was replaced with Don Murray in the band because of that
he had a band of his own in New York did he go immediately to a band of his own do you recall?
